title: 第129章 睡什么睡起来嗨
slug: 我在战锤抽词条帝皇站起来了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

卡尔加其实挺烦这些灵族的，但是伊芙蕾妮是救了他爹的人，所以卡尔加还是保持住了基本的礼貌。

伊芙蕾妮也不是拎不清的人，虽然灵族非常高傲，但是她在面对需要为灵族挡住混沌的极限战士的时候，也保持住了基本的礼貌。

大魔是现实世界头号威胁，每次出现都意味着行星级灾难，是现实世界种族的共同敌人。

卡班哈更是有匹敌原体的半神战力，统领恶魔军团与混沌叛军。

伊芙蕾妮的声音从投影里传出来：“卡班哈带领的恶魔军团已经进入奥特拉玛星域，随行的还有至少三支混沌叛军舰队的残部。”

卡尔加没有说话，等她说出真正的来意。

死神军不是慈善组织，不会无缘无故地跑来送情报，他们出现在这里，一定有他们的目的。

果然，伊芙蕾妮的下句话就跟了上来：“摄政王还没有赶到吗？”

普通军队只能对付普通军队，在原体级别的大魔之前，普通军队已经失去了意义，还是要靠原体来。

卡尔加沉声说：“父亲先前已经对我传来具体消息，他大概还有半天时间就能赶到马库拉格。”

刚刚好基里曼之前就已经在回援的路上了，现在只剩下最后一段路程，马上就能到了。

他们拖住恶魔大军一会就行。

伊芙蕾妮点点头。

“那么我们将会为极限战士提供网道安全通道，大裂隙动向，卡班哈的实时位置，混沌邪教在奥特拉玛的潜伏节点。此外死神军的灵能者可以协助极限战士进行亚空间防护和灵能支援，在对抗大魔的战斗中，灵能屏障和灵能打击必不可少。”

灵族一直和人类看不对眼，但是很偶尔的时候，他们也会和理智的极限战士合作。

只有让人类帝国顶在前面，灵族才是安全的。

灵族和极限战士之间的合作是不公开的合作，合作完就散。

无信任，纯交易，写死条款，不得透露给帝国官员和审判庭。

灵族提供网道安全通道，大裂隙动向、大魔位置、邪教节点之类的绝密情报，帮极限战士进行亚空间防护和灵能支援。

极限战士战团这边容忍死神军在奥特拉玛和帝国边缘行动，不主动攻击，提供舰队战士和死神军一起去打混沌势力。

威胁解除即终止同盟，互不干涉内政，灵族不碰人类信仰和领土，人类不碰灵族的方舟和魂石。

战场指挥分离，联盟秘密进行，国教审判庭不知情。

威胁一退，立刻翻脸，老死不相往来。

这是整场合作最关键的一条，也是最敏感的一条。

帝国官方对异形的态度是见一个杀一个，尤其是灵族这种和人类有血海深仇的种族。

如果被国教或者审判庭知道极限战士和灵族合作，别说合作了，连坐在同一张桌子前谈判都能被扣上一顶勾结异形的帽子。

有灵族合作最好，但是其实没灵族合作也行。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Calgar was actually quite annoyed by these Eldar, but Evrene was the one who saved his father, so Calgar still maintained basic courtesy.

Efreni is not someone who can't handle things clearly. Although the Eldar are very arrogant, she still maintains basic courtesy when facing the Ultramarines who need to block Chaos for the Eldar.

The big demon is the number one threat in the real world. Every time it appears, it means a planet-level disaster. It is the common enemy of all races in the real world.

Ka'banha even has the power of a demigod to rival the original body, commanding the demon legions and Chaos rebels.

Everene's voice came from the projection: "The demon army led by Kabanha has entered the Ultramar star field, accompanied by the remnants of at least three Chaos rebel fleets."

Calga said nothing, waiting for her to tell her true purpose.

The Death Army is not a charitable organization and will not come here to deliver information for no reason. They must have their purpose when they appear here.

Sure enough, Evelyn's next words followed: "Hasn't the Regent arrived yet?"

Ordinary armies can only deal with ordinary armies. Before the Great Demon at the level of the original body, ordinary armies have lost their meaning, and they still have to rely on the original body.

Calgar said in a deep voice: "Father has sent me specific news before. He will arrive at Macragge in about half a day."

It just so happened that Guilliman had already been on his way back to help, and now there was only the last stretch of the journey left, and he would be there soon.

They can just hold off the demon army for a while.

Ephrene nodded.

"Then we will provide the Ultramarines with a safe passage through the web, the movement of the Great Rift, the real-time location of Kabanha, and the Chaos Cult's latent node in Ultramar. In addition, the psykers of the Death Army can assist the Ultramarines with subspace protection and psychic support. In the battle against the Great Demon, psychic barriers and psychic strikes are indispensable."

The Eldar have always been at odds with humans, but occasionally, they will cooperate with the sane Ultramarines.

Only by keeping the human empire at the front can the Eldar be safe.

The cooperation between the Eldar and the Ultramarines is a closed cooperation and will break up after the cooperation is over.

No trust, pure transaction, hard-written terms, which must not be disclosed to imperial officials or the Inquisition.

The Eldar provide top-secret information on the safe passage of the Webway, the movement of the Great Rift, the location of the Great Demon, and the nodes of the cult, and help the Ultramarines with subspace protection and psychic support.

The Ultramarines chapter tolerates the Death Army operating on the edge of Ultramar and the Empire, does not take the initiative to attack, and provides fleet warriors and the Death Army to fight the Chaos forces together.

The alliance will be terminated when the threat is removed, and they will not interfere in each other's internal affairs. The Eldar will not touch the human faith and territory, and the humans will not touch the Eldar's Ark and Soul Stone.

The battlefield command was separated, and the alliance was carried out in secret without the knowledge of the Ecclesiastical Tribunal.

As soon as the threat was withdrawn, they immediately turned against each other and stayed away from each other until death.

This is the most critical and sensitive aspect of the entire cooperation.

The official attitude of the empire towards aliens is to kill every one they see, especially the Eldar, a race that has a blood feud with humans.

If the Ecclesiarchy or the Inquisition knew that the Ultramarines were cooperating with the Eldar, let alone cooperating, even sitting at the same table to negotiate would be labeled as colluding with the aliens.

It's best to cooperate with the Eldar, but actually it's okay without the Eldar.
